mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk asset allocation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs. zero return).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 235.5 signals accelerating inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs. zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages indicate robust consumer spending that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both above 12-month MA) fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a monthly payroll increase exceeding 0.5% (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer confidence and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), the signal (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate stronger economic data.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is rising (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs. zero return).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 900 signal a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth concerns intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 900 (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs. zero return).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and declining unemployment (UNRATE falling > 0.2% MoM) signals dovish monetary policy and labor market improvement, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: dovish monetary policy with labor improvement
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE falling > 0.2% MoM) fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2%), rising housing starts above 0.5% MoM (HOUST > 0.5% MoM) indicate sustained consumer demand that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2% annualized), the signal (HOUST > 0.5% MoM) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05).
